meta.name: DNA Helix
meta.description: A rotating double helix. Two instanced-circle strands run vertically, their x offset by a sine whose phase differs by pi so the strands cross; z-depth is faked by modulating each bead's size and alpha with the cosine of its phase. Rotation accumulates with dt * (base + mid), so the helix turns faster with midrange energy. Spectrum bands swell each bead's local radius. A third instanced layer draws rungs connecting the strands every few beads. Silence slows the spin and dims the beads to a calm idle.
